tasks.title: Low-waste school event
tasks.instruction: You have received this email from your English teacher, Mrs. Clark.

promptBlocks.subject: Low-waste school event
paragraphs: Our school is planning a low-waste event to help the environment. I'd like your ideas. What kind of event do you suggest, and why? Also, how can we encourage students to take part?
I look forward to your reply.

promptBlocks.heading: Your notes:
listItems: Event idea: a swap shop for books and clothes – reduces waste and is fun.
Reason: students can exchange things they no longer need instead of throwing them away.
Encouragement: offer a small prize for the class that brings the most items.
Preference: I think a swap shop is better than a workshop because it's more interactive.

tasks.title: Helping at a school event
tasks.instruction: Your school magazine is asking for articles about how students can help at school events. Write an article for the magazine.

promptBlocks.heading: Write an article for the magazine.
paragraphs: What can students do to help at school events? Do you think it's important to help? What simple things can you do?
Share your ideas in an article for the magazine.

tasks.title: A school fair
tasks.instruction: Your English teacher has asked you to write a story for homework. Your story must begin with this sentence:

promptBlocks.text: When I arrived at the school fair, I saw my friend waving at me.
